versions.changelog: Narrowed scope to NotebookLM slide-deck footer-badge masking, replaced machine-specific paths with portable skill paths, and added safer defaults: no metadata/annotation stripping unless explicitly requested, no source overwrite, and no output overwrite without --force.
Initial release: clean NotebookLM-exported slide deck PDFs by masking the visible bottom-right footer mark, stripping lightweight PDF extras, and writing a cleaned copy without touching the original.
